dedupe_keys.name: turkey syria 2023 earthquake impact estimates from near real time social media and remote sensing

description: This dataset gives near-real-time estimates of the impacts of the 2023 magnitude 7.8 and 7.5 Turkey-Syria earthquakes, built from social media and remote sensing data. It was published on DesignSafe-CI in 2023 by Susu Xu and Xilei Zhao, with a second version. It provides spatial estimates of building damage probability, communication network outages, evolving casualty reports in Turkey and Syria, and changes in population density and human movement after the earthquakes. Coverage: affected areas of Turkey and Syria. Access: DesignSafe Data Depot, project PRJ-3858. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: estimates from crowdsourced and remote sensing signals carry uncertainty, and the record does not describe validation. Simulation uses: rapid damage and displacement estimation, and planning of rescue and recovery with time-evolving data. Related records: the ODDRIN point building damage data and the STEER reconnaissance series.
